parsed.notes:
Minimum qualifications are required; Preferred qualifications are optional. Responsibilities, company descriptions and benefits do not independently establish skill requirements.
PyTorch and Transformers are alternatives for the ML-library ask; comparable libraries add no criterion.
Machine learning and software engineering each have independent required support beyond the initial alternative experience wording.
Language-model training maps to model development and LLMs; post-training is not assumed to mean fine-tuning specifically.
Human evaluation and LLM-as-judge calibration collapse into the independently required evaluation criterion.
Experimental design, inference execution, debugging, recommendation metrics and online experimentation are read literally rather than equated with statistics, model serving, software testing, recommender systems or A/B testing respectively.
Gaming is treated as domain knowledge, not a skill.
